example_summary: Reconciliation of Book Profit with Income Tax Provisions for Parik Hospitality Limited for A.Y. 2026-27.
source_provision:
### Master Statutory Summary Matrix

| Area / Provision | Statutory Section / Rule | Operative Threshold / Condition | Tax Treatment / Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cash Payments** | Section 40A(3) read with Rule 6DD | Expenditure exceeding ₹10,000 in cash per day per person | Disallowed 100% unless covered by Rule 6DD exceptions (e.g. cultivators/fishermen) |
| **Pension Contribution** | Section 36(1)(iva) & Section 40A(9) | Employer contribution towards notified pension scheme | Allowed up to 14% of salary; excess over 14% is disallowed u/s 40A(9) |
| **TDS on Transport** | Section 194C & Section 40(a)(ia) | Payments to transport contractors opting for Section 44AE | No TDS liability if PAN and presumptive declaration are furnished |
| **Intra-Group Transfer** | Section 47(iv) | Transfer of capital asset to a 100% subsidiary Indian company | Not regarded as transfer; capital gains not chargeable |
| **TDS on Director Fees** | Section 194J & Section 40(a)(ia) | Fees paid to independent directors for attending Board meetings | TDS deductible under Section 194J; 30% disallowance u/s 40(a)(ia) on default |


> [!IMPORTANT] Statutory Traps in PGBP:
> - Capital vs Revenue: Expenditure on projects not related to existing business and abandoned without creating an asset is treated as capital expenditure and disallowed.
> - TDS Defaults: Non-deduction of tax from professional or managerial fees attracts a 30% disallowance under Section 40(a)(ia).


> [!WARNING] Cash Payment Rule Exceptions:
> Rule 6DD provides specific relaxations for payments made to producers of products (like agricultural produce, fish, or livestock) directly, but middlemen or agents do not enjoy these exemptions.

director.justification: The question requires a comprehensive computation ledger starting from book profit and adjusting various additions and deductions under PGBP and other heads.
director.visual_metaphor: An escalating ledger adjustment scale where book profits are systematically reconciled with tax statutes.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Establish the starting net profit from the Statement of Profit and Loss.
Analyze cash disallowances for payments exceeding statutory limits under Section 40A(3) and Rule 6DD.
Examine pension contributions and salary caps under Section 36(1)(iva) and Section 40A(9).
Verify transport contractor TDS exemptions with presumptive taxation under Section 44AE and Section 194C.
Evaluate capital gains exemption on asset transfers to 100% subsidiaries under Section 47(iv).
Process director fee TDS defaults and consequential disallowances under Section 194J and Section 40(a)(ia).
Summarize final total income computation and Chapter VI-A deductions.
Conclude with key takeaways regarding statutory additions and deductions in PGBP computations.
